KXSPRRELEASE.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXSPRRELEASE.rules_primary: If a new U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve release announcement is confirmed by any of the Source Agencies after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXSPRRELEASE.rules_secondary: A qualifying announcement must commit to releasing additional SPR crude oil beyond quantities publicly announced before this market opened. Sales and exchanges qualify. Solicitations, contract awards, or deliveries implementing previously announced quantities do not qualify. Proposals, statements considering a release, and purchases to replenish the SPR are excluded. Physical delivery need not occur before the deadline. Both the announcement and confirmation by a Source Agency must occur before January 1, 2027.
KXSPRRELEASE.title: Will a new U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve release announcement be confirmed before Jan 1, 2027?

KXSPRLVLDATE.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the condition is met.
KXSPRLVLDATE.rules_primary: If the US SPR level is above 300 million barrels before January 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXSPRLVLDATE.rules_secondary: The US SPR level is the value on Table 1 of the U.S. Energy Information Administration's Weekly Petroleum Status Report (U.S. Petroleum Balance Sheet), row “Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR)”, under the Current Week column. The market resolves to Yes if any Weekly Petroleum Status Report released after Issuance and before the date in the market's title shows that value above 300 million barrels. A report released on or after that date does not count, even if the week it covers ended before it. The value as first published for each week governs; later revisions are not counted.
KXSPRLVLDATE.title: Will the US SPR level be above 300 million barrels before January 1, 2028?

KXDOESPRTENDER.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXDOESPRTENDER.rules_primary: If the U.S. Department of Energy announces issuing a solicitation to exchange or sell crude oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXDOESPRTENDER.rules_secondary:
A solicitation means a competitive Request for Proposal or Notice of Sale formally issued by the U.S. Department of Energy and open for bids.

The solicitation must be newly issued after this market opens. An award announcement, amendment, extension or re-issuance of a solicitation issued before that date does NOT count
A solicitation to purchase or acquire crude oil to refill the Reserve does NOT count
A statement of intent, a budget proposal, congressional testimony or an inventory report that does not itself open a bidding process does NOT count
A solicitation that is issued and later cancelled before award still counts, because the trigger is the issuance
KXDOESPRTENDER.title: Will the U.S. Department of Energy announce issuing a solicitation to exchange or sell crude oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve before Jan 1, 2028?
